# Questions:
1. Squirrels found eating are more likely to be found above ground
2. When squirrels are seen approaching humans, they will be more likely to be twitching their tail than squirrels that are indifferent
3. Squirrels will tend to spatially cluster with other squirrels of the same color
4. Squirrels will be more vocal in the morning than the afternoon
5. Squirrel tail flags will correlate with squirrels that run from humans
